description: Calculate US take-home (net) pay from a salary or an hourly wage for 2026, after federal income tax (from the Form W-4), Social Security, Medicare and the state's own income tax and payroll contributions, in any of the 50 states or DC. Use it for 'how much will I take home on $X in <state>?', for comparing states, or to price an offer; it also returns the full-year totals and what the employer pays on top. Use us_bonus_tax instead for tax withheld from a bonus, overtime_pay for the extra pay for overtime hours before tax, and hourly_to_salary for converting pay between hour, week, month and year without tax. Assumes the 2026 federal withholding method and the state's published employer withholding formula, one job, and a W-4 filed in the standard way.

annual_salary_usd.description: Yearly gross salary in US dollars. Required when pay_type is salary. For example 60000.

filing_status.description: Filing status on the federal Form W-4, step 1(c): single (or married filing separately), married (filing jointly) or head (head of household). Default single.

health_premiums_usd_per_paycheck.description: Pre-tax health, dental and vision premiums per paycheck, in US dollars. Default 0.

hourly_rate_usd.description: Hourly wage in US dollars. Required when pay_type is hourly. For example 25.

hsa_usd_per_paycheck.description: Pre-tax HSA contribution through payroll per paycheck, in US dollars (capped at the 2026 family limit). Default 0.

local_tax.description: Id of a city or county income tax to include (for example 'nyc' or 'yonkers' for New York). Leave out for none; an unknown id returns the ids that state accepts.

overtime_hours_per_week.description: Overtime hours per week paid at time and a half, hourly pay only. Default 0.

pay_frequency.description: How often the employee is paid: weekly (52 paychecks a year), biweekly (26), semimonthly (24, twice a month) or monthly (12). Default biweekly.

pay_type.description: Whether the employee is paid a yearly salary or an hourly wage. Default salary.

regular_hours_per_week.description: Regular (straight-time) hours per week, hourly pay only. Default 40.

state.description: Two-letter postal code of the state where the employee works and lives: all 50 states and DC (for example CA, NY, TX, DC).

state_allowances.description: Allowances or exemptions on the state's own withholding form, for states that have one. Leave out to use the typical single worker's number for that state.

traditional_401k_percent.description: Pre-tax 401(k) contribution as a percentage of gross pay, 0 to 100 (capped at the 2026 IRS limit). Default 0.

w4_children_under_17.description: Qualifying children under 17 for Form W-4 step 3 (a $2,200 credit each in 2026). Default 0.

w4_deductions_usd_per_year.description: Deductions above the standard deduction, Form W-4 step 4(b), in US dollars per year. Default 0.

w4_extra_withholding_usd_per_paycheck.description: Extra federal withholding per paycheck, Form W-4 step 4(c), in US dollars. Default 0.

w4_other_dependents.description: Other dependents for Form W-4 step 3 (a $500 credit each). Default 0.

w4_other_income_usd_per_year.description: Other income not from jobs, Form W-4 step 4(a), in US dollars per year. Default 0.

w4_step2_checkbox.description: The 'multiple jobs or spouse works' box in Form W-4 step 2(c). Default false.

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
